review.decision: Bind Go layout reads to the length returned by stat on the open descriptor.
review.notes: Addresses one finding of independent review 100e601a. The deterministic reader injects exact, short and long snapshots without a scheduling race. No runtime validation or independent approval of the change is claimed.

cases.description: A Go layout document must match the size of the open file.
cases.setup: A bounded reader with injected stat sizes, plus a private journal and marker fixture.
cases.action: Read an exact snapshot and reject parseable bytes shorter or longer than the stat size. Resolve a valid active layout at the byte limit, then extend the journal or marker by a byte.
cases.expected: Only the matching length is accepted. Invalid length and over-limit documents never select the active layout or a legacy fallback.
